items.headline: Albemarle reports Q3 adjusted EPS $2.58, consensus $2.53
items.snippet: Reports Q3 revenue $1.6B, consensus $1.57B. Global lithium demand is up 48% year-to-date through August, driven by both electric vehicles and energy storage.
